units: Y. Kil. VII, end, 31ᵃ יִסְפּוֹר he (who is in possession of property bought from an oppressor, v. אַנָּס) must count (settle with the original owner according to rules, v. גוֹרְדְּיָינִי), opp. יחזיר he must return the property; ib. יִסְפֹּר (or יְסַפֵּר Pi.).
<cite ref="Niddah 69a:14">Nidd. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>סוֹפַרְתָּן למנין וכ׳</he> she counts them in with the requisite number of seven days.
<cite ref="Niddah 31a:69">Ib. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>יושב וסוֹפֵר וכ׳</he> sits and records the copulations &c.

<cite ref="Menachot 65b">Men. 65ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01378"><he>סְפִירָה</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 33">Sifré Deut. 33</cite> <he>סופרה</he>; read: <he>סופנה</he>, v. <cite ref="O01386"><he>סָפַן</he></cite>.]—Part. pass. <cite ref="O01338"><he>סָפוּר</he></cite>, q. v.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:8">Bekh. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>שנִסְפֶּרֶת ע״ג היד</he> when the additional finger is counted (is in a line) with the others; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 156">Yalk. Sam. 156</cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 49b:16">Sot. 49ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מְסַפֵּר קומי</he>, v. <cite ref="S00391"><he>קוֹמִי</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Sotah 49b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>התירו</he> (<he>לו</he>)<he>לסַפֵּר וכ׳</he> they allowed him to cut his hair in gentile fashion, because of his connections with royalty. Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII <he>תִּסְפּוֹר</he>, v. <cite ref="S00391"><he>קוֹמִי</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:19">Tosef. Bets. III, 19</cite> <he>אין מְסַפְּרִין הירק וכ׳</he> you must not no trim vegetables with the clipper (on the Holy Day) &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to tell, speak, count. Y. Kil. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> (ref. to <he>אברם</he> in place of <he>אברהם</he>, <cite ref="Nehemiah 9:7">Neh. IX, 7</cite>) <he>סיפור הוא מְסַפֵּר וכ׳</he> he states a historical fact, saying &c. Y. Ber. IX, beg. 12ᵈ <he>אם בא אדם לסַפֵּר וכ׳</he> if one were to undertake to count the mighty deeds of the Lord, he would be ruined (ref. to <cite ref="Job 37:20">Job XXXVII, 20</cite>); <he>המספר בשבחו וכ׳</he> he who tells the praise of the Lord more than is becoming.
<cite ref="Job 37:20">Ib.</cite> <he>מכאן … אסור לסַפֵּר וכ׳</he> beyond that (which has been adopted in ritual prayers) one must not tell &c.

<cite ref="Arakhin 16a:10">Arakh. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם אל יְסַפֵּר אדם בטובתו וכ׳</he> man should not count up his neighbor’s good qualities, for he may be induced to speak of his shortcomings; <cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:15">B. Bath. 164ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:10">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>בלשון ארמי סי׳</he> spoke Aramæan; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52b:1">Ib. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>סי׳ הימנו</he> if he (the scholar) holds conversation with him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:2">Ab. Zar. II, 2</cite> <he>אין מִסְתַּפְּרִין מהן וכ׳</he> you must not have your hair cut by them in any place (on account of danger to life).

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:5">Tosef. ib. III, 5</cite> <he>ישראל המִסְתַּפֵּר וכ׳</he> if an Israelite has his hair cut by a gentile, he must look into the mirror; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a">Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
